entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Today the matter has been moved because the Consent Terms inter-alia provide that the Applicant-wife would give her no objection to the quashing/withdrawal of the criminal proceedings bearing RCC No. 4878 of 2018 filed under Section 380, 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 against the Opponent-husband.

The Consent Terms also provide that the Opponent-husband shall withdraw criminal OCTOBER 17 2023 Laxmi 31 IA 4038-23.doc case registered as RCC No. 1546 of 2020 filing number 30817 of 2020 pending before the Civil Judge, Senior Division and Additional CJM, Nashik under Section 120B, 403, 406, 415, 420 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 against the Applicant's father-Mr. Gul Thadani and the Applicant's brother in law-Mr. Chetan Bora.

entities.text: Civil Judge, Senior Division and Additional CJM, Nashik
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It was further agreed that the Opponent-husband shall give his no objection to the quashing/withdrawal of the criminal proceedings filed against these persons.
There was also an issue regarding the joint locker No. 636A in Bank of Baroda, Shivaji Nagar, Pune, currently sealed by the Bank.

The Consent Terms provide that this locker would be opened, if necessary, by breaking open the lock/s in the presence of both the parties and all the belongings therein would be handed over to the Applicant-wife in presence of the Branch Manager of the concerned Bank or the Court Commissioner (any senior lawyer of the Family Court, Pune).
3.
The matter has been moved today because there is some dispute between the parties in relation to the opening of the aforesaid locker and also in relation to the quashing proceedings.

4. The learned Advocate appearing for the Applicant-wife has stated that as per clause (6) and (7) of the Consent Terms, the original OCTOBER 17 2023 Laxmi 31 IA 4038-23.doc consent affidavit (for quashing) of the Applicant-wife as well as the original documents of the Nashik Flat have been handed over to her.
5. The Applicant-wife who has appeared before us today through virtual hearing has undertaken to this Court that she will not change her lawyers until the quashing proceedings finally come to an end.
The said undertaking is accepted.

In light of this, the parties have agreed before us today that at the time of quashing of the proceedings against the Applicant's father and the Applicant's brother in law, the Advocate for the Applicant-wife shall hand over the original documents of title pertaining to the Nashik Flat to the Advocate for the husband.

6. As far as the locker is concerned, the parties have agreed before us that the joint locker No. 636A in Bank of Baroda, Shivaji Nagar, Pune would be opened (if necessary by breaking open the lock/s)
in the presence of the Applicant-wife and the Opponent-husband on 27 th October, 2023 and the belongings therein shall be handed over to the wife in the presence of the Branch Manager of the concerned Bank or the Court Commissioner (any senior lawyer of the Family Court, Pune).

7. A copy of this order shall be forwarded by the Advocates for the Applicant-wife as well as the Opponent-husband to Bank of Baroda OCTOBER 17 2023 Laxmi 31 IA 4038-23.doc immediately, so that the said Bank can take necessary steps for the purpose of breaking open the lock/s of joint locker No. 636A.

9.
